claim_boundary: This is a charged source-locked ideal-RD architecture oracle, not an emitted codec and not achieved reconstructed-weight MSE. A charged failure is a valid early stop for this exact-tail/support-XKLT/RHT-polar family because every omitted finite-code effect favours it. Free-side rows are diagnostic only.

read_ledger.claim_boundary: Compressed-object traffic only; RHT/XKLT/polar reconstruction must be fused with expert GEMMs to avoid a dense-weight HBM materialization.

decision.rule: A hard kill requires both the best exhibited charged row to miss F<=0.8 and an F>0.8 Lagrange-dual lower bound for the complete frozen grid at every rate and residual geometry.

matched_gaussian_controls.construction: PCG64DXSM normal -> BF16 RNE symbols, then one conceptual exact energy normalization per matrix; every control repeats tail search, side coding, support XKLT and joint integer-bit waterfill

method.one_joint_waterfill: all residual components across all experts share one water level; real allocations are closed to exactly the integer physical payload bits by largest exact one-bit marginal reduction
optimism: ideal asymptotic Gaussian residual RD with no finite polar/lattice shaping loss
source-fitted KLT basis is treated as exact after a Q15-sized angle ledger
no RHT padding or block-boundary loss
tail values are exact, so their source-domain error is zero
method.robust_bulk: known support is partitioned by the 7 nonempty role masks; an exact source-fitted KLT is applied inside each support pattern, followed by a procedural orthogonal RHT and an ideal Gaussian polar-lattice test channel
method.tail_selection: per-matrix stable top absolute BF16 value; ties use canonical flat ordinal
method.value_code: lossless BF16 words; best of literal16, canonical word Huffman, magnitude+sign Huffman, and sign/exponent/mantissa Huffman; 2-bit mode is inside each charged descriptor

contents.allocation: one panel-wide reverse waterfill closed to exact integer payload bits

charged_tail_stream.support: fixed-length combinatorial number system with ceil(log2 C(N,k)) bits
charged_tail_stream.values: minimum exact length among literal BF16, canonical word Huffman, magnitude/sign Huffman, and sign/exponent/mantissa Huffman

contents.claim_boundary: This protocol gates one exact-lossless-tail architecture. It is not a converse for lossy tail quantization, learned semantic support, or arbitrary nonlinear codecs.

early_kill.global_certificate: enumerate all 20^3 expert-local tail triples, minimize D+mu(side+payload) independently for all six experts, and maximize the resulting weak-duality lower bound over positive mu
early_kill.promotion_rule: only a charged ideal-RD F <= 0.8 warrants a finite CuPy polar-lattice run; a hard kill additionally requires a complete-grid Lagrange-dual lower bound F > 0.8 for every rate and both residual geometries
early_kill.stronger_diagnostic: also report a mask-charged envelope with exact tail values and XKLT basis revealed for free

matched_controls.construction: normal samples rounded RNE to BF16 symbols and conceptually rescaled to exact per-matrix source energy

contents.residual_channel: procedural orthogonal RHT followed by an ideal Gaussian polar-lattice test channel
residual_geometries: support-pattern-conditioned expert-local Gate/Up/Down XKLT robust bulk
contents.tail_selection: stable per-matrix top absolute BF16 value; canonical flat ordinal breaks ties
